name: ktm-lang
description: ktm: a compiled language for systems programming and networking (REST microservices, network daemons, system tools) on Linux and macOS

paragraphs: ktm is a small compiled language for systems programming and networking: REST microservices, network daemons and command-line tools. Its syntax is C-like, with modules, methods, defer, scoped enums and real error values. The compiler, written in C, builds native x8664 and AArch64 binaries ahead of time, runs programs directly with a built-in JIT, and comes with a REPL, a language server and a standard library organised into modules (strings, containers, JSON, files, sockets and TCP/UDP helpers, processes, signals, coroutines, threads, dates, optional SQLite).
Sources are .ktm files; a directory of them is a module.
